title: OK, With Issues
text:
OK, With Issues. This product appears to be a really sturdy, functional over the sink organizer. There are, however, a few issues with assembly and quality. The side pieces are tubular stainless, but not very high quality. One of the big selling points is the adjustability of the item to fit most sink areas. One of my telescoping pieces fell apart as soon as I removed the bag, and the second one was jammed together so tightly I had to use a screwdriver to pry the tubing apart to get the center piece lose.
The protective scratch peel on the silverware holder was impossible to remove without scratching the stainless anyway and took longer to get off the whole rest of the assembly.
Versatile ability to set up the spacing and arrangement of the accessories. Be wary of overloading especially if you are putting breakables in the top basket.
